info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Cancellation API provides a seamless way for users to cancel their rideshare bookings. This endpoint facilitates the cancellation process for rides that have been scheduled, ensuring that users can manage their travel plans efficiently. Typical consumers include rideshare service providers and mobile application developers looking to implement ride management functionalities within their applications. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experience by providing them with the ability to easily cancel their rides when needed.

delete.description: This endpoint allows the user to cancel a previously requested ride. Once the request is made, the system will process the cancellation, and if successful, the ride will no longer be active.

requestBody.description: Provides the information necessary to cancel a ride. This includes any relevant identifiers or cancellation reasons that are required for processing the cancellation request.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: Represents the request body for canceling a ride operation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.title: Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier representing the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Descriptive message about the outcome of the cancellation.

audit.description: Object containing audit information regarding the cancellation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.description: Response object for the cancellation operation of a ride.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: User who created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit information related to the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. A lower value generally indicates better performance.
